name: Inconsistent or synthetic identity data at onboarding
description: Identity documents, contact details, geolocation or device data do not align, suggesting fabricated, stolen or misrepresented identity.
fp: Travel, VPN use and data-entry errors can create benign mismatches; seek corroborating documents.

links.name: Accounts opened with synthetic or stolen identities
Freelancer or contractor accounts with identity and location inconsistencies
links.ctx: Remote worker profile shows mismatched documents, geolocation and payment details.
links.fp: Remote workers legitimately use VPNs and travel.

links.name: Organiser account shows identity inconsistencies
links.ctx: Organiser identity documents, contact details or IP geolocation do not align with claimed location or purpose.
links.fp: VPN use and travel create geolocation mismatches.

links.name: Onboarding with weak identity evidence and shared devices
links.ctx: Multiple accounts opened with synthetic or inconsistent identity data from common devices.
links.fp: Households and shared devices are common.
